en.t: Prince Genji replied, "I would not dare!

units.source_text: 小婿并不善于调度，只是多方搜求贤才，勉尽己责而已。

en.t: Your son-in-law is not skilled at arranging such matters; I have merely searched in every direction for worthy talent and done my best to fulfill my duty.

units.source_text: 纵观万般技艺，惟头中将之《柳花苑》尽善尽美，真乃后世表率。

en.t: Looking across every kind of art, only To no Chujo's Willow Flower Garden is flawless, truly a model for later generations.

units.source_text: 大人若肯当此盛世之春，欣然起舞，更可为天下增光也。”

en.t: If my lord would graciously dance in this springtime of a flourishing age, it would add even greater splendor to all under heaven."

units.source_text: 此时左中弁和头中将进来了。

en.t: Just then, Sachuben and To no Chujo came in.

units.source_text: 三人共倚栏前，各取所爱乐器，合奏雅调，其音悠扬悦耳。

en.t: The three of them leaned together by the railing, each took up his favored instrument, and played an elegant melody in ensemble, its sound lingering and pleasant to the ear.
